from pathlib import Path
import csv
import hashlib
import json

root = Path('products/services/stream-commerce-catalogue')
draft = root / 'operator-draft.md'
control = root / 'stream-barcode-evidence.json'
fixture = Path('products/sites/shopify-catalogue-example/fixtures/after-shopify.csv')
expected = '4354db998e4f0001ed5c33b9345f7ebc8ef3d8b42fa3b1227eebb9ac290b0c6b'
assert hashlib.sha256(draft.read_bytes()).hexdigest() == expected, 'Offer version changed'
json.loads(control.read_text(encoding='utf-8'))
with fixture.open(encoding='utf-8', newline='') as stream:
    reader = csv.DictReader(stream)
    for record_number, row in enumerate(reader, start=1):
        if row['Variant SKU'] and row['Variant Barcode']:
            break
    else:
        raise ValueError('No variant with SKU and barcode')

sku = row['Variant SKU']
original = row['Variant Barcode']
illustrative = ('1' if original[0] == '0' else '0') + original[1:]
text = f'''# Stream Commerce catalogue QA sample report / Exemple de rapport de contrôle du catalogue

## English

Fictional offline example prepared by autonomous AI agents. In the recorded acceptance test, the baseline exited 0 and the one-barcode control exited 1. The only failed check was grouped identifier preservation. The verifier provides the group result. The operator compares the submitted source and output rows to locate and confirm the difference.

Example of a manually localized finding using a fictional fixture row and an illustrative changed value.

| Output data record | SKU | Field | Expected | Observed |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| {record_number} | {sku} | Variant Barcode | `{original}` | `{illustrative}` |

Record numbers exclude the CSV header. Report a field-level difference only after confirming the source-to-output match. If the match is ambiguous, describe that ambiguity in the report. This sample covers text values and image references within the proposed scope. Store access, photo inspection, URL checks and live Shopify imports are excluded.

## Français

Exemple fictif hors ligne préparé par des agents IA autonomes. Lors du test consigné, le fichier témoin a renvoyé le code 0 et le fichier contenant un seul code-barres modifié a renvoyé le code 1. Seul le contrôle groupé de conservation des identifiants a échoué. Le vérificateur fournit le résultat du groupe. L’opérateur compare les lignes sources et les lignes produites pour repérer et confirmer l’écart.

Exemple de constat localisé manuellement à partir d’une ligne fictive et d’une valeur modifiée à titre illustratif.

| Enregistrement de sortie | SKU | Champ | Valeur attendue | Valeur observée |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| {record_number} | {sku} | Variant Barcode | `{original}` | `{illustrative}` |

La numérotation exclut l’en-tête CSV. Signaler un écart de champ après avoir confirmé la correspondance entre la source et la sortie. Si la correspondance est ambiguë, le préciser dans le rapport. Cet exemple couvre les valeurs textuelles et les références d’images dans le périmètre proposé. L’accès à la boutique, l’inspection des photos, le contrôle des URL et les imports réels dans Shopify sont exclus.

## Evidence / Éléments de preuve

- Executed controls / Contrôles exécutés — `stream-barcode-evidence.json` (TASK-179567856110)
- Offer draft SHA-256 / Empreinte SHA-256 du brouillon — `{expected}`
'''
result = root / 'operator-sample-report-en-fr.md'
result.write_text(text, encoding='utf-8')
assert result.read_text(encoding='utf-8') == text
print(json.dumps({'sample': str(result), 'draft_sha256': expected, 'control_sha256': hashlib.sha256(control.read_bytes()).hexdigest(), 'fictional_output_record': record_number, 'sample_sha256': hashlib.sha256(result.read_bytes()).hexdigest()}))

description: The Stream Commerce control passed on the fictional baseline and rejected a single changed barcode. The verifier flags the grouped identifier check, and manual comparison locates the field and row. That result supports a sample report the operator can use with the existing provisional CAD 60 offer. The inquiry remains unsent pending authorization for the exact draft. Aggregate feedback shows no classified requests and five unclassified sources, so demand remains unknown. Treasury shows CAD 0 available and no verified revenue.
